WITH scope AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as num_observatories
  FROM scope
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.telescope_count,
  CAST(s.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / m.total_telescopes as share,
  CAST(s.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / m.total_telescopes - (1.0 / m.num_observatories) as difference_from_average
FROM scope s, metrics m
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10
